claims.claim: exp-004 generated English, Japanese, and bilingual mixed calibration data and English/Japanese evaluation data.
claims.notes: Manifest records 64 calibration samples for each condition and 24 evaluation samples for English and Japanese.

claims.claim: exp-004 produced three NVFP4 W4A4 Qwen3-4B variants calibrated on English, Japanese, and bilingual mixed instruction data.
All exp-004 NVFP4 variants had higher NLL than the base model on both English and Japanese evaluation text.
claims.notes: Every non-base row has positive delta_nll_vs_base.

claims.claim: English calibration was the best quantized variant on English evaluation text.
Bilingual mixed calibration was the best quantized variant on Japanese evaluation text in this pilot.
claims.notes: best_quantized_by_language.japanese_instruction is nvfp4_lang_bilingual_mixed; the margin over Japanese-only is small.
